principle: ORGANIZATION != POLITY != SPECIES != CULTURE != CITIZENSHIP != MEMBERSHIP != POSITION != RANK
rules: An organization may exist without owning territory.
Political sovereignty and organizational authority are separate.
Species composition never defines organization membership automatically.
Organization membership does not imply citizenship or personal loyalty.
Rank/grade systems are organization-specific and optional.
Positions and ranks are separate dimensions.
Sub-organizations may inherit policy/authority constraints but retain their own identity.
After campaign start, live organizational state may diverge from future screen canon through represented events.
